name: Potiphar's Wife
title: The Temptress in Egypt
summary: Potiphar's wife was an Egyptian woman married to Potiphar, the captain of Pharaoh's guard. She is known for repeatedly attempting to seduce Joseph, and when he rejected her, she falsely accused him of attempted rape, which led to Joseph being thrown into prison.

keyEvents.title: Attempted Seduction
keyEvents.description: Potiphar's wife noticed Joseph's beauty and tried day after day to seduce him, but Joseph consistently refused to sin against God and his master.

keyEvents.title: The Decisive Confrontation
keyEvents.description: When she was alone with Joseph in the house, she grabbed his cloak and demanded that he lie with her, but Joseph fled, leaving the cloak in her hands.

keyEvents.title: False Accusation Against a Servant
keyEvents.description: She called out to the servants of the house, showed them Joseph's cloak as evidence, and accused him of attempting to assault her.

keyEvents.title: Accusation to Potiphar
keyEvents.description: When her husband came home, she repeated the false accusation and showed him the cloak, which led Potiphar in anger to have Joseph thrown into prison.
